rooms.name: Throne Room
rooms.description: Grand hall with golden throne and festival tapestry
rooms.unlock_text: You enter the Throne Room. King Aldric waves you over.

rooms.name: Steward's Study
rooms.description: Cozy room with oak desk, errand board, and knight rank chart
rooms.unlock_text: Pip leads you down the corridor to the Steward's Study.

rooms.name: Castle Kitchen
rooms.description: Cavernous kitchen with iron pots and recipe archive shelves
rooms.unlock_text: The smell of burnt pastry guides you to the Castle Kitchen.

rooms.name: Chronicle Hall
rooms.description: Vaulted chamber with glowing memory crystals and timeline table
rooms.unlock_text: The Chronicle Hall's heavy doors swing open. Memory crystals glow on the shelves.

rooms.name: Castle Gate
rooms.description: Massive stone gatehouse with conduit pipes and connection diagrams
rooms.unlock_text: The Castle Gate looms ahead — the controlled passage to the outside world.

rooms.name: Bedrock Bazaar
rooms.description: Bustling town square marketplace with colorful merchant stalls
rooms.unlock_text: You step through the Gate into the bustling Bedrock Bazaar.

rooms.name: Foreign Quarter
rooms.description: Colorful district of silk canopies, spice stalls, and unfamiliar scripts
rooms.unlock_text: Colorful foreign banners mark the entrance to the Foreign Quarter.

rooms.name: Entertainment Guild
rooms.description: Theatrical hall with miniature stage model and booking sheets
rooms.unlock_text: A grand stage entrance leads into the Entertainment Guild.

rooms.name: Noble Quarter
rooms.description: Elegant district of manicured gardens and heraldic banners
rooms.unlock_text: Manicured hedges line the path into the Noble Quarter.

rooms.name: The Proving Ground
rooms.description: Open field with training dummies and Champion assembly platform
rooms.unlock_text: Sir Cedric stands at the gate. "Show me what you've built."
